o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آغاج (aġac), from Proto-Turkic *ïgač. Cognate with Turkish ağaç.
Morphologically from qalxmaq (“to rise”) + -dır, with /x/ in qalxmaq being lost via syncope. Cognate with Turkish kaldırmak.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آرا (ara), from Proto-Common Turkic *āra.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish برو (bärü), from Proto-Turkic *berü. Compare Turkish beri, Gagauz beeri.
Calque of Russian нача́ло координа́т (načálo koordinát).
